name: Do I need to clean out the property before painters arrive?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to clean out the property before painters arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is beneficial if the property is emptied of personal belongings and debris before our team begins painting. While we can move small items, extensive clutter or large furniture will hinder our progress and may incur additional charges for removal or relocation. A clear workspace allows us to prepare surfaces thoroughly and paint efficiently, ensuring a higher quality finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: It's best if the property is emptied of belongings and debris before painters arrive, as extensive clutter can delay work and incur extra costs.
